13:19.text: Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding -

13:20.text: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allāh and do not break the contract,

13:21.text: And those who join that which Allāh has ordered to be joined
and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of

13:22.text: And those who are patient, seeking the face
of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of

13:23.text: Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate,

13:24.text: be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."

13:25.text: But those who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.

13:26.text: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts
. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except

13:27.text: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say,
, "Indeed, Allāh leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back

13:28.text: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured."
